Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Detalhes do projeto

Procuramos por Business Analyst para participar e entregar o roadmap de desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas que suportarão a refatoração de um conjunto de demandas estruturais. O foco será o atendimento da crescente demanda de revisão de processos de negócio, debatendo a estratégia e priorização das soluções com as equipes de negócio/operações e técnicas em busca do melhor retorno para a empresa e clientes de modo a sempre endereçar escalabilidade, disponibilidade e segurança.

title: Remote Biology Expert - 78715
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Biology Expert - 78715 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have a solid foundation in Biology, particularly at the level expected in engineering entrance exams, as well as graduate or PhD-level programs. You should be able to break down complex biological concepts into simple, clear explanations and work efficiently. The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Responsibilities:

  • Design and solve challenging Biology problems to probe the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop high-quality, step-by-step solutions with clear and rigorous reasoning.
  • Collaborate with LLM researchers to align problem types with evaluation goals, especially in areas where models typically struggle (e.g., conceptual abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and data interpretation).
  • Contribute to defining new evaluation benchmarks based on Biology curricula spanning early undergraduate to PhD-level topics.


Required Qualifications:

  • Candidates with a Master’s or Ph.D., or those currently pursuing a Ph.D./Postdoctoral degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong research and analytical skills.
  • Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Excellent structured communication and collaboration skills in a remote setting.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Access to a desktop/laptop with a reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to analyze and solve complex biological problems with a structured, logical approach.
  • Ability to explain biology concepts clearly using simple language, visuals, and simulations where needed.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Sr. TypeScript Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. TypeScript Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Sr. TypeScript Developer to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Brazil or North America

Industry: IT & Services


Sr. TypeScript Engineer | About You

As a Sr. TypeScript Engineer, you are responsible for delivering high‑impact features in a fast‑moving, AI‑assisted development environment. You are deeply experienced in AI‑driven and agentic development workflows, using tools such as Claude and/or Cursor to significantly increase development speed, quality, and iteration velocity. You are comfortable with vibe coding, working fluidly with AI to explore solutions, refine implementations, and ship results quickly. You thrive in sprint‑based teams with clear deadlines, take ownership of complex workstreams, and consistently perform at a high output level. You are comfortable collaborating with distributed teams and ramping quickly on new codebases, tooling, and workflows.


Sr. TypeScript Engineer | Day-to-Day

  • Build, refactor, and deliver production‑ready features using TypeScript in a modern application stack.
  • Leverage advanced AI coding tools (Claude and/or Cursor) as a core part of your daily development workflow, including agentic and iterative coding patterns.
  • Apply agentic development workflows to break down problems, generate solutions, validate approaches, and accelerate delivery.
  • Work within sprint cycles, committing to scoped deliverables and consistently meeting assigned deadlines.
  • Deliver a high volume of story points per sprint, aligning with top‑tier performance benchmarks.
  • Collaborate closely with senior engineers and technical leadership to solve complex technical problems.
  • Review and improve existing code while maintaining performance, readability, and scalability.
  • Participate in technical discussions and help shape best practices for AI‑assisted and agentic development.


Sr. TypeScript Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in software development, engineering, or a closely related role, delivering production‑ready applications in fast‑paced environments.
  • Strong, hands‑on fluency with TypeScript, including building and maintaining scalable, maintainable code within modern application architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience with agentic development workflows, using AI to plan, iterate, validate solutions, and accelerate engineering tasks from end‑to‑end.
  • Recent, dedicated experience using Claude and/or Cursor at an advanced level, leveraging these tools for high‑velocity, high‑quality development beyond basic code generation.
  • Comfortable with vibe coding, working interactively with AI to explore approaches, refine implementations, and quickly converge on production‑ready outcomes.
  • Proven ability to deliver high output in sprint‑based development environments, consistently meeting or exceeding expectations for scoped work and story point delivery.
  • Fluent or very strong English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed, cross‑functional teams.

description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, workshops e palestras (principalmente em espanhol) sobre GCP;
  • Desenvolver demonstrações práticas (hands-on) e provas de conceito (PoCs);
  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, resilientes e seguras;
  • Atuar em estratégias de migração para cloud (cloud migration);
  • Colaborar com times técnicos e de negócio na qualificação de oportunidades;
  • Disseminar boas práticas, tendências e inovações em cloud;

  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio em toda a América Latina.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de soluções em cloud e desenho de soluções escaláveis;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações e arquiteturas cloud-native e serverless;
  • Experiência com serviços GCP como Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Monitoring e Cloud Logging;

  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento de sistemas distribuídos;

Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. description:

Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de um Designer de Apresentações com forte experiência em criação de layouts, templates e narrativas visuais, capaz de seguir guidelines de marca com excelência estética e transformar conteúdos complexos, incluindo materiais médicos e científicos, em apresentações claras, estratégicas e visualmente atraentes. Procuramos um profissional com domínio de Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, olhar apurado para hierarquia visual, acessibilidade e storytelling, habilidade para resolver problemas de design com agilidade e interesse constante por novas tendências e ferramentas inovadoras.

Inglês fluente é mandatório pois trabalhamos em projetos internacionais com times globais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver apresentações estratégicas, dinâmicas e visualmente sofisticadas, garantindo consistência com as diretrizes de marca, excelência estética e adaptação para diferentes formatos e dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
  • Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;
  • Gerenciar o processo de desenvolvimento de apresentações do início ao fim, incluindo alinhamento com stakeholders, construção da narrativa, criação de layouts, incorporação de feedbacks e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Ser responsável pela revisão final e controle de qualidade das apresentações antes do compartilhamento, assegurando clareza, consistência visual e precisão das informações;
  • Trabalhar de forma independente ou colaborativa com outros designers, gerenciando múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e mantendo alta performance em ambientes de ritmo acelerado.


Requerimentos & Skills:

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em Design de Apresentações, com formação superior (bacharelado) em Design, Artes Visuais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de apresentação, incluindo PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote e Prezi, além de proficiência em ferramentas essenciais do dia a dia, como Word e Excel, para organização, edição e estruturação de conteúdos e dados
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. Espera-se domínio de hierarquia visual, organização da informação, escolha adequada de visualizações, simplificação de conteúdos densos e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma intuitiva para diferentes públicos.
  • Conhecimento em animação e construção de apresentações interativas, utilizando transições e motion design para criar narrativas visuais fluidas, dinâmicas e envolventes
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de design e edição visual, como Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign) e/ou Figma, para criação e refinamento de assets gráficos, layouts e materiais de apoio
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas à automação e otimização de processos criativos, como Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Gamma, Adobe Firefly e recursos de IA integrados ao Photoshop
  • Forte repertório em design gráfico, com domínio de tipografia, teoria das cores, hierarquia visual, contraste, grids/alinhamentos e princípios de composição, além de olhar apurado para criar materiais limpos, sofisticados e profissionais;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e gerenciamento de projetos, com capacidade para atuar em múltiplas demandas simultaneamente;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.

  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.

  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.

Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.

The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Infrastructure Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in the core technology areas listed below, with a broad understanding of adjacent infrastructure disciplines.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in change management and project planning activities.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT Infrastructure experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Cisco UCS — including blade/rack server administration, Fabric Interconnects, UCS Manager (UCSM) or Intersight, service profiles, and firmware management.
  • Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting complex multi-system infrastructure issues.
  • Experience designing and implementing infrastructure solutions.


Preferred

  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE Data Center, VMware VCP-DCV, Citrix CCP-V, or equivalent cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT infrastructure projects.
  • Experience with enterprise storage platforms.

Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React

We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.

We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de plataformas e componentes reutilizáveis para o ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos.
  • Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Desenvolver frameworks, aceleradores, templates e padrões técnicos que facilitem o desenvolvimento e a implantação de modelos por diferentes times.
  • Atuar na integração entre modelos de ML, pipelines de dados, APIs, microsserviços, feature stores, serviços de inferência e plataformas cloud.
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de CI/CD para Machine Learning, incluindo testes automatizados, validação de dados, validação de modelos, quality gates e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes.
  • Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e arquiteturais sobre o uso de Machine Learning em contextos críticos do negócio financeiro.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Machine Learning, MLOps, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento prático do ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning em produção: desenvolvimento, treino, versionamento, deploy, monitoramento, sustentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento, code review, modularização e documentação técnica.
  • Conhecimento em construção e orquestração de pipelines de dados e/ou ML, utilizando ferramentas como Airflow, Step Functions, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS, incluindo serviços relacionados a processamento, armazenamento, orquestração, APIs, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em containers, APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída, como Docker, Kubernetes, serviços REST/gRPC ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados.
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de Data Science e negócio em soluções técnicas reutilizáveis, escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com plataformas de model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, model serving e model monitoring, utilizando ferramentas como MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks, Feast, Evidently, WhyLabs, BentoML, KServe ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de plataformas internas para Machine Learning, com foco em self-service, padronização e reuso.
  • Experiência com modelos em ambientes de alta escala, alta disponibilidade ou baixa latência.
  • Conhecimento em governança de modelos, explicabilidade, documentação, auditoria, gestão de risco, qualidade de dados e compliance.


Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse:


  • Conhecimento em LLMOps, RAG, agentes de IA, gateways de LLMs, avaliação de respostas, controle de custos e observabilidade para IA generativa.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA generativa e integração com LLMs, como LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM.
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis.
  • Familiaridade com LGPD, princípios de Responsible AI e governança de dados.

The specialist will work with carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities

  • Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"\"at-risk\"\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.
  • Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

  • Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

Technical Requirements:

  • Data Handling: 4-5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.
  • SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

  • Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements:

  • Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.
  • Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"\"noisy\"\" data, and propose actionable solutions.
  • Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
  • Prior Forecasting experience

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento e suporte de integrações utilizando webMethods e webMethods.io. Essa pessoa atuará no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de integrações críticas entre sistemas internos e parceiros externos, garantindo estabilidade, performance e continuidade operacional dos ambientes de integração.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter integrações utilizando webMethods Designer, Flow Language, Flow Services e Workflows.
  • Atuar no suporte e troubleshooting de integrações em ambientes on-premises e cloud.
  • Implementar melhorias e correções em integrações existentes, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com módulos B2B e Integration do webMethods.io para criação e manutenção de integrações.
  • Apoiar clientes e áreas internas na definição e entendimento de cenários de integração.
  • Monitorar integrações e atuar na resolução de incidentes e análises de causa raiz.
  • Desenvolver scripts e ferramentas de apoio para automação e evolução dos processos da equipe.
  • Participar de projetos de manutenção, expansão e modernização da plataforma de integração.
  • Realizar documentação técnica e promover compartilhamento de conhecimento com o time.
  • Atuar em ambiente ágil, participando de cerimônias Scrum, PI Planning e acompanhamento de atividades junto à gestão e times técnicos.

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em webMethods utilizando Flow Language via Designer.

  • Conhecimento em protocolos e serviços de rede:
  • DNS

  • Conhecimentos básicos de Linux para atividades de suporte e manutenção de servidores.

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência com integrações B2B.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud e integrações híbridas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e atuação próxima a Scrum Master.
  • Experiência com apresentações técnicas e interface com clientes globais.

Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Infraestrutura em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Infraestrutura (Operações SaaS /Cloud /Suporte N 1).

Nossos clientes são alguns dos maiores players do mercado Global.


Sobre a área:

A área de Operações SaaS é responsável pela sustentação, disponibilidade e performance dos ambientes de clientes na nuvem, garantindo a continuidade dos serviços, o cumprimento de SLAs e a atuação proativa em incidentes e mudanças.


Responsabilidades:

Monitorar e operar a infraestrutura de clientes em ambiente OCI, garantindo disponibilidade, performance e segurança;

Executar procedimentos operacionais de rotina (start/stop de serviços, validações pós-mudança, checks de saúde, testes de conectividade, etc.);

Atuar no atendimento Nível 1, realizando triagem, análise inicial, classificação e encaminhamento de incidentes, requisições e problemas;

Registrar, atualizar e acompanhar chamados em ferramenta de ITSM, garantindo qualidade das informações e cumprimento de SLAs;

Apoiar na execução de janelas de manutenção e GMUDs, seguindo procedimentos padronizados e garantindo a comunicação com as áreas envolvidas;

Realizar análises básicas em logs de aplicação e de sistema para identificação de causas prováveis e direcionamento adequado;

Colaborar com times de Infra, Desenvolvimento e Suporte Aplicacional na investigação de incidentes e na implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas;

Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de scripts, playbooks, checklists e automações de monitoração e operação;

Participar da documentação de procedimentos operacionais, incluindo runbooks e FAQs para atendimento de primeiro nível;

Apoiar testes e validações em ambientes de certificação/homologação quando necessário;


Requisitos obrigatórios :

Experiência prévia em operações de TI, suporte técnico, infraestrutura ou NOC/Command Center;

Conhecimentos básicos em sistemas operacionais (Linux e/ou Windows Server);

Noções de redes (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, balanceamento, conectividade entre clientes e nuvem);

Familiaridade com ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente OCI; experiência em AWS/Azure/GCP também é considerada);

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoração (infra e/ou aplicação) e abertura/atualização de chamados;

Conhecimento básico de SQL para consultas simples e análise de dados/logs;

Boa capacidade de comunicação, organização e registro de informações;

Disponibilidade para atuação em regime de plantão, escalas e janelas de manutenção (incluindo horários noturnos e fins de semana, quando necessário);


Diferenciais desejáveis:

Experiência em operações de ambientes SaaS e atendimento a clientes corporativos;

Conhecimento em OCI (compartimentos, instâncias, VCN, storage, etc.);

Vivência com ITIL (incidentes, problemas, mudanças);

Experiência com ferramentas de automação e orquestração (por exemplo, Power Automate, scripts em Shell/PowerShell, etc.);

Noções de observabilidade (logs centralizados, métricas, dashboards);

Certificações em nuvem ou infraestrutura serão consideradas um plus.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / Angular / Azure) | Remote (Brazil) | $R20,000 per month


We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2B SaaS business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.


The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical SaaS platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.


The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.


The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

  • Full-stack development; .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core on the backend, Angular / TypeScript on the front
  • Real-time application development using SignalR
  • Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor)
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices
  • Multi-tenant white-label SaaS architecture
  • Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction


This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience
  • Strong .NET / ASP.NET Core and Angular / TypeScript skills
  • Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Cloud-native development on Azure
  • Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding
  • PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database experience
  • Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity
  • Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.


Why This Role

  • Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust
  • Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Treasury Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company’s credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.

The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)

• Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.

• Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.

• Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.

• Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.

• Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.

• Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.

• Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.

• Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.

• Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.

• Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.

• Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.


Cash Management & Treasury Operations

• Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.

• Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.

• Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.

• Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.

• Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.

• Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.

• Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.

• Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.

• Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities.

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.

• Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.

• Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization.

Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

Professional Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.

• Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.


Technical Knowledge

• Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.

• Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.

• Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.

• Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.

• Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Languages

• Advanced English (required).

• Intermediate Spanish (desirable).


Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

Job description:
